svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Memory hierarchy - RAM is volatile; disk is not
svg.desc: The memory hierarchy of an agent harness in four tiers. Tier 1, always-RAM, is volatile and billed every turn: CLAUDE.md importing AGENTS.md, the 6 unconditional rules (00-overview, agent-guardrails, model-policy, ai-governance, task-tracking and conventional-commits, joined by output-style when the terse flag is set), the agent's own body, and its tool schemas. Tier 2, lazy-RAM, is also volatile but billed only on touch: 9 path-scoped rules carrying a paths frontmatter glob, four of which are installed only when a flag asked for them, and which together hold 63 percent of the 16 rules' content. A red boundary line marks that everything above it is already lost. Below it, tier 3, disk, is durable committed markdown: the master-plan board, one task file per task with its append-only session log, and the committed disabled.json ledger recording which rule, command or hook has been turned off. Tier 4, the archive, is append-only and capped: the run archive under .claude/state/history, written by the agent-history hook on SubagentStop, whose detail level is a choice of full, summary, minimal or off and whose retention cap keeps only the newest N per-run files.
svg.text: Memory hierarchy - RAM is volatile; disk is not
What an agent carries in context, and what actually survives when the context goes away.
CLAUDE.md -> @AGENTS.md (the contract, imported into every session)
6 unconditional rules in .claude/rules/ - 7 with the terse flag (no paths: to scope them)
the agent's own body / system prompt + its tool schemas, shipped every request
Loaded every session, every agent. Re-injected after compaction.
9 path-scoped rules, each carrying a paths: frontmatter glob
4 of the 9 above are flag-gated (testing, data-model, ddd, frontend); output-style makes 16 rules in all.
63% of the rule content. Enters context only when Claude touches a matching file.
Everything above this line is ALREADY LOST - you just have not noticed yet
One row per task: ID, title, owner, status, branch. It must agree with the task file.
Goal, acceptance criteria, decisions and blockers, session log appended as work happens.
.claude/disabled.json - committed: which rule, command or hook is off, and why.
Survives compaction, session end, a crashed agent, a dead IDE.
.claude/state/history/ - written by the agent-history hook on SubagentStop
Detail is a choice: full | summary | minimal | off. summary truncates to 1500 chars.
A retention cap keeps only the newest N per-run files; 0 means never prune, not keep-none.
What each subagent was asked and answered - and how much of it you chose to keep.
